## Checklist

- [ ] The PR is linked to an issue and has a Conventional Commits title
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes locally (format, lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] I added or updated tests for the changes
- [ ] E2E tests are added or updated if a critical user journey changed
- [ ] `.env.example` and `src/lib/env.ts` are updated if I added an environment variable
- [ ] Documentation (README, `docs/`, ADRs) is updated where needed
- [ ] UI changes were checked on mobile (360px) and desktop, in light and dark themes
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files or generated artifacts are committed
